control_failures.control_label: proving zero energy before intrusive work

facts.title: preventive action - alarm rationalisation on P-7113

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 2 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the proving zero energy before intrusive work on P-7113, M-7113 and TK-7104 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in applying and verifying an isolation, specifically proving dead and testing for zero energy. P-7113 (export transfer pumps) is in service for tank-to-jetty product transfer, same seal class as the Marrindal family. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the proving zero energy before intrusive work was never verified as effective. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 13 April 2021 a corrective action on P-7113, M-7113 and TK-7104 at Cape Verity Export Terminal was reviewed against the critical control it was raised to restore.
